summary: Peace seeps In deep cuts Of ruts and broken lust; As effort eclipses Perfection unchased in Impossible Notches of not knowing tomorrow's Future. So you cut away At Yesterday's game. #smallpoems #writingcommunity
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Peace seeps
In deep cuts
Of ruts and broken
lust;
   As effort
eclipses
  Perfection
unchased in
   Impossible
Notches of not
knowing tomorrow's
Future.
      So you cut away
At Yesterday's game.
